params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 shows off its in-game kids' TV show "Macca & Friends" Rockstar Games has released the first footage of Macca & Friends, a TV show you can watch inside GTA 6. It stars a sunglass-wearing pink alligator and his wetland friends in Leonida, the game's take on Florida, with Rockstar's usual satirical humour. GTA 6 launches in less than a week. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 18:13 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 😂 React if you'd watch this in-game · 💬 Best GTA TV show ever? #GTA6 #RockstarGames #Leonida #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
